The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

I checked every page of the category. It has two pages, and five of its books are rated five stars. The other four cost £23.05, £25.37, £48.35 and £52.30. The category's first page is still open in my tab.

I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin.org accepted it. I left the result page (`https://httpbin.org/post`) open in the tab I opened.

The server's echo of the submitted form shows these values:
- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and cheese (the form's value for Extra Cheese)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

The order is complete. The final page, "Checkout: Complete!" with the message "Thank you for your order!", is still open in the tab I opened.

I logged in as standard_user and sorted the products by price from low to high. I added the Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and the Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99), then checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001.

The order total was $43.18: $39.98 for the items plus $3.20 tax.

Some of the browser tool's clicks didn't register, so I triggered the Checkout, Continue and Finish buttons through the page's own scripts instead. The order itself went through normally.
